quote: Granite-4.2-8B is post-trained from [Granite-4.1-8B-Base](https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-4.1-8b-base) through a rigorous multi-stage pipeline that progressively unlocks reasoning, tool use, and instruction-following capabilities. [...] The SFT stage draws on instruction-following, chain-of-thought, and reasoning data to cultivate the model's reasoning and thinking abilities. [...] The final stage of training applies multi-phase, multi-environment reinforcement learning using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). value: The card gives some rationale for training choices: SFT uses instruction-following, chain-of-thought and reasoning data to cultivate reasoning and thinking abilities; hyperparameters were tuned before scaling to all three model sizes; for the 30B model a second SFT phase up-sampled agentic data while retaining a smaller share of general replay data. RL uses GRPO across multiple environments, with verifiable rewards where available and a generative reward model for open-ended prompts; an RLHF phase tunes helpfulness, conversational quality, and safety.
quote: The SFT stage draws on instruction-following, chain-of-thought, and reasoning data to cultivate the model's reasoning and thinking abilities. [...] Hyperparameters were tuned before training was scaled to all three model sizes. [...] For the 30B model, we conducted a second SFT phase, in which the agentic data was up-sampled while a smaller share of general replay data was retained. [...] Most environments provide verifiable rewards, while open-ended prompts are scored by a generative reward model. [...] After the reward-driven phases, a preference-alignment (RLHF) phase tunes helpfulness, conversational quality, and safety.
quotes: The SFT stage draws on instruction-following, chain-of-thought, and reasoning data to cultivate the model's reasoning and thinking abilities.
Hyperparameters were tuned before training was scaled to all three model sizes.
For the 30B model, we conducted a second SFT phase, in which the agentic data was up-sampled while a smaller share of general replay data was retained.
Most environments provide verifiable rewards, while open-ended prompts are scored by a generative reward model.
After the reward-driven phases, a preference-alignment (RLHF) phase tunes helpfulness, conversational quality, and safety.
